notes: Build-verb -> catalog-type mapping (owner 2026-07-10 generic build-mode; WO-673 taxonomy 2026-07-11). ONE generic entry BuildModeController.EnterBuildMode(BuildType) is parameterised by 'buildType'; each row maps it to the CatalogType(s) that feed its palette + the unlock-gated ids to filter. Loaded at startup by BuildCategoryRegistry (Village) via CanonicalJson (Resources-first, WebGL-safe). Keep the Resources + StreamingAssets copies byte-equal. 'buildType' / 'catalogTypes' are enum NAMES (StringEnumConverter). 'lockedIds' are catalog ids kept in the catalog but filtered out of THIS verb's palette until their unlock ships. WO-673 (owner ruling 2026-07-11, displays Town / Defenses / Walls): Town = the player-placed functional buildings (Resource + Collector, always on -- WO-682 removed ff.strategicplacement 2026-07-13; supersedes the 2026-06-27 'Defensive only' palette ruling); Defense keeps towers/gates; Walls split out (claimed-outpost wall canon). The jeweler unlock-gate moved from Defense to Town (it is a Resource row). Collector/Support remain as standalone legacy verbs.
